verdict.rationale: Railway's docs claim auto-configuration and private connections between services that are live from deployment, and say the platform makes provisioning infrastructure easy. Its MCP server can also pull variables, which hints at platform-managed configuration. However, nothing in the pack describes binding-style wiring to databases, APIs or storage that removes hand-written SDK and credential setup. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of provisioned databases or storage with auto-injected connection credentials or reference variables, any storage or object-bucket binding, examples showing reduced boilerplate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
